create_JustKeepGoingEnv_wrapper: create a JustKeepGoingEnv wrapper around a CompilerGym environment to prevent step and close from raising exceptions
run_JustKeepGoingEnv_step: run a step on a JustKeepGoingEnv wrapped environment that catches exceptions and returns default observation and reward
run_JustKeepGoingEnv_reset: run reset on a JustKeepGoingEnv wrapped environment with up to 5 retry attempts on failure
run_JustKeepGoingEnv_close: run close on a JustKeepGoingEnv wrapped environment that silently ignores any close errors
review_JustKeepGoingEnv_class: review the JustKeepGoingEnv class that wraps CompilerEnvWrapper to handle step reset and close exceptions gracefully
